category.reason: The task combines a nightly price limit and a free-cancellation requirement, then compares the qualifying hotels by straight-line distance to a specific landmark on the map.

instruction.en: Of the hotels that cost US$250 or less per night and offer free cancellation, find the price marker on the map for the one closest in a straight line to the “Duffy Square” center marker.
instruction.zh: 在每晚价格不超过 250 美元且可免费取消的酒店中，找到离 “Duffy Square” 中心标记直线距离最近的一家，并定位它在地图上的价格标记。
